name: Yamaha YSR50
engine: 49 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, Autolube oil injection, five-speed
intro: Yamaha's tiny sport bike. A two-stroke with Autolube and a frame that racers love to modify.

B: It has oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump line for cracks.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
